description: This file defines a controller class for handling product reviews within an OpenCart e-commerce platform. It includes methods for displaying reviews, submitting new reviews, handling pagination, captcha verification, and managing review-related data.

classes.name: Review
classes.description: Controller class for managing product reviews, including listing, adding, and verifying reviews with support for pagination and captcha.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the display of the review page, loads necessary data, scripts, language, and captcha if applicable.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Outputs the list of reviews for a specific product, primarily intended for AJAX calls.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and prepares review data for a given product, including pagination.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Processes user submissions for new reviews, validating inputs, captcha, purchase history, and saving the review if all checks pass.
